messages:
maya: kicking off a quick sanity protocol for the new lumenx-3b variant on dev-staging. posting the checklist + early observations now.

sam: which model tag and runtime? link to the artifact?

maya: model: lumenx-3b:v0.9-quant, runtime: redwood-infer/rtc-1.2 (cuda12), region: us-west2 dev-stg cluster. artifact: gs://redwood-models/lumenx/0.9/manifest.json

ellie: quick checklist suggestion (minimal for now):
- tokenization roundtrip (emoji + zwnj cases)
- trivial QA (factoid answers)
- stop-sequence handling (###)
- streaming chunk boundaries (prefix continuation)
- kv-cache consistency across batched continuation
- basic perf (p50/p95 per-token)

jun: saw tokenization mismatch on emoji + ZWJ: input "🏳️‍🌈" tokenized -> [9901, 4, 0] but baseline -> [9901, 6]. reproducer:```echo "🏳️‍🌈" | rwt tokenize --model lumenx-3b:v0.9```

maya: thanks, will add a unit test and a small fuzz that includes emoji/zwnj. filed a tiny ticket: MODEL-5232

sam: can we run a float vs quant quick compare on the small eval set? want basic EM/accuracy numbers + token-level diffs. i can run if you push the run command.

maya: running now: `rdw eval --model lumenx-3b:v0.9-quant --baseline lumenx-3b:v0.9-fp32 --prompts evals/smoke_prompts.yaml --out /tmp/lumenx_quant_cmp.csv --metrics em,exact_match,perplexity`

ellie: perf snapshot: batch=1, kv disabled -> p50 token latency 115ms, p95 210ms on a2g-small; token throughput ~9 tok/s for long sequences. memory stable.

jun: quality note: code generation sample returned truncated JSON for the toy prompt (missing closing brace). suspect stop-token handling in quant path. sample output attached in run logs.

deploy-bot: container lumenx-3b:v0.9-quant deployed to dev-stg node-7 (build 2026-03-19T14:05Z). CI smoke triggered.

sam: i'll run full quant comparison overnight and drop the CSV into /evals/lumenx/1998754321-quant-compare.csv, will include token-diff col and a small summary markdown.

maya: next steps: (1) fix tokenizer edge cases (emoji/ZWJ) (2) debug stop-sequence truncation in quant path (3) add a tiny CI smoke that runs the 8 sanity prompts on every dev-stg deploy. tagging @sam @jun. thanks :thumbsup:

ellie: +1 on CI smoke, add p95 perf threshold too to catch regressions.

jun: will take the tokenizer fix, pushing a patch to the dev branch and adding unit tests.

maya: closing thread for now, will followup with the quant vs fp32 numbers when available. ping here if you see weird outputs during ongoing tests.
